SELECT -- ======================= -- Product -- ======================= p.product_id, p.product_cod, p.product_name, p.product_price, p.product_img, p.product_info, p.product_registration_status, p.product_status, p.product_group, p.group_id, p.product_quantity, p.product_order_quantity, p.product_delivery_quantity, p.product_file_path, p.file_category, p.file_name, p.category_id, p.vendor_id,
-- ======================= -- Category (alias 필수) -- ======================= c.parent_id AS category_parent_id, c.name AS category_name, c.sort_order AS category_sort_order, c.is_active AS category_is_active, c.created_at AS category_created_at, c.updated_at AS category_updated_at
FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id -- 이건 .product_status 컬럼과 is_active 컬럼이 혼용되어 있기에 컬럼 통일시킨후 주석 해제한다. -- WHERE p.product_status = '판매' -- AND (c.is_active = 1 OR c.is_active IS NULL)
ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, p.product_id ASC

SELECT p.product_img, p.product_Registration_status, p.product_info, p.product_status, p.product_id, p.product_cod, p.product_name, p.product_group, p.product_file_path, p.file_category, p.file_name, h.old_price, h.new_price, h.changed_at FROM product p INNER JOIN product_price_history h ON p.product_id = h.product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MAX(changed_at) AS max_changed_at FROM product_price_history GROUP BY product_id ) latest ON h.product_id = latest.product_id AND h.changed_at = latest.max_changed_at WHERE
p.group_id = #{groupId} AND h.old_price != h.new_price ORDER BY p.product_id;
